title: SANARWA GA DUKKAN MANOMA

headings.text: Abubuwan da kowane manomi zai zo da su

key_sentences: Shugabannin ƙungiya suna sanar da dukkan manoma ’yan ƙungiya cewa za a fara rabon iri da taki na noman rani a ranar Litinin, 9 ga watan Nuwamba, 2026.
An tanadi buhunan iri dubu ɗaya da ɗari biyu da kuma buhunan taki dubu uku don wannan kakar.
Farashin da ke sama an rage shi da kashi arba’in cikin ɗari saboda tallafin gwamnati.
Ba za a ba da iri ko taki ga wanda bai yi rajista ba kafin ranar ƙarshe.
Duk wanda aka kama yana sayar da kayan tallafi a kasuwa za a kore shi daga ƙungiya.
Rabon zai fara da ƙarfe takwas na safe kuma zai ƙare da ƙarfe huɗu na yamma.

notes: One-page Hausa farmers' cooperative notice in a framed poster layout. Letterhead (3 lines) is furniture. Hausa hooked letters (ɓ, ɗ, ƙ) are precomposed code points; the apostrophe of ’yan is U+2019. The title is typed in capitals. The checklist markers are check marks drawn by CSS ::before, so items are given without them. In the distribution table the total label 'Jimla' spans three columns.
